title: Grading Checklist
lines: get into habit of keeping tetra not capped, especially P1
☐ ☐ ☐ ☐ 1st DoT refresh (0:29 when tethers just came out): Dia +Sprint +Temp, G3 +Caress
Preposition 1 if tether, between D and center
☐ Wave Cannon: Be at the north edge of D
☐ Check confetti immediately after soaking towers
☐ Use 2 lilies when MM2 starts casting (one will resolve after confetti)
Aim towards MM2 safe spot if not confetti
Dodge MM2 in far safe spot
☐ ☐ ☐ 2nd DoT refresh (0:58 or shortly after LJ1 start casting): Dia +Indulgence +Lucid
Check for puddle or rock via wiggling
☐ Manage RR2 OT invuln (static: ensure Aerry is healed past walking dead)
Check for puddles or rock via wiggling
Middle if puddle, side and then middle if rock
Check for HP, make sure we're topped off pre- and post-confetti
☐ Pop bell right after KB if confetti
☐ ☐ Dia and PoM after gravity resolves
☐ Manage MT invuln (static: heal Alystin after third hit)
Top off the party with raptures
Be in center and orient to D
Only slidecast between arrows or if arrows near NW and going to confetti
☐ ☐ Assize + Caress on the same GCD after confetti
Always go to C, don’t go to D if I’m a confetti
☐ Refresh DoT on the last GCD before getting stunned
☐ Lucid when it comes up during MM3
MM3: If confused debuff, don’t slidecast; If under 17%, don’t slidecast
Beeline to 3, adjust to C if it’s spread; solve in/out afterwards
☐ ☐ End with at least 1 lily and exactly 2 blood lily charges
☐ ☐ Ultimate Embrace: Aqua MT, Benison OT
Move to D right after this resolves
☐ Forsaken: Indul when it starts casting
☐ ☐ ☐ ☐ ☐ Forsaken: Dia +Pot +Asylum, Rapture +PoM when it finishes
T1: Assize, and that should be enough healing. Misery for movement
☐ Check to make sure I can get G4s before expiration/pot wears off
T6: Don't lily. Misery for movement around this time.
☐ ☐ ☐ Dia, Indulgence, and Temperance (in that order)
☐ T8: Make sure party is topped off. Rapture
☐ ☐ Benison MT and OT on the next GCDs
☐ Go near the wall in direction of wind crystal during Dia
☐ TB1: Regen Aerry when she gets hit
☐ BoA 2nd: Temperance on second hit of lat/long
Try to watch Kefka myself—shouldn't have to rely on callouts
☐ Med 3 + Caress when I get knocked back
☐ Post-LC: Shift into center and Med3
☐ Manage MT invuln (static: benison and regen Alystin after done)
☐ Burn raptures and Misery before Decisive Battle 2
☐ Tetra the lower tank on the Rapture

BH8 = support 2 unaccretion & 3 swap, heal tank if needed
